name: Youfukunaoshi
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood clothing alteration and repair shop (Suzuran Youfuku Naoshi-ten): a notice about business hours changing, a first day working part-time at the shop, a usage-and-price guide, a first time trusted alone with hemming a pair of pants, a comparison of two new-staff training plans, a column about a friend coming to get clothes altered for a job interview for the first time, teaching a junior staff member how to use the sewing machine, an essay on why alteration-shop use keeps growing, a temporary closure notice for store renovation, a column on tailoring the proposal to different kinds of customers, a notice of revised request rules, an essay on old clothes being mended back to life, and a one-year cooperation report with a local welfare group about remaking old clothes. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
